description: Venezuela Earthquake: Road Blockages is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Planetary Response Network. We have assessed primary and secondary roads for signs of road blockages in the La Guaira, Districto Capital, Yaracuy and Carabobo regions of Venezuela. The latest updated data, uses imagery dated 15th August 2026. The data is held in a shapefile format using the WGS 84 EPSG: 4326 projection. Coverage: Venezuela, Bolivarian Republic of. The portal files it under the publisher Planetary Response Network. Its tags are crisis-venezuela-earthquake, damage assessment, logistics, roads. It offers 4 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2026-08-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution International (CC BY). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
